claim: Opening: "The tubes on screen are not a visualization of the filter — they are the filter, drawn in space"; the LPC reflection coefficients are the impedance mismatches between tube segments. A 446-word page asserting a playable identity.

pieces.what: Opens on one junction between two tubes of different area: a pulse goes in, part reflects, and the reflection coefficient is read off the area ratio; then stacks segments into the tract and morphs /a/ to /i/ to /u/, with the same coefficients driving the lattice filter you hear
pieces.walks_up_from: one impedance step between two cylinders

pieces.what: The vowel morph and the melody demo as audio beside the area-function plot, testing that one vowels.json drives sound and picture alike
The three proof clips (glottal source, scattering junction, tube morph) as video in the band
Per-vowel spectrograms laid beside the tube profiles so formant positions can be checked against tract shapes
